meta.name: content-writer
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and content improvements following Google's E-E-A-T and Helpful Content guidelines. Handles new content creation from a keyword or topic, and improving existing pages. Use when asked to "write a blog post", "create a landing page", "improve this page", "write content about X", "content for keyword X", "draft an article", "blog post about", "landing page for", "service page", "product page copy", "rewrite this page", "make this page rank better", "content brief", "how-to guide", "listicle", or any content creation or improvement task for a website.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把主题写成符合谷歌指南的博客和落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要靠高质量内容吸引更多读者
copy.tagline_en: Turn your topic into blog posts and landing pages that rank on Google
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website needs helpful content to attract more readers

howto.what: 它会按 Google 的 E-E-A-T 和“有用内容”指南,撰写 SEO 优化的博客文章、着陆页,或改进现有页面;产出包括正文、SEO 元数据、结构化数据等;改进时给出改写内容和变更摘要。动笔前会先判断任务类型。
howto.when: 当用户要求“写博客文章”、“创建着陆页”、“改进此页”等,或提出任何网站内容创建或改进任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于「本地 SEO」的博客文章
say.note: 它会先做意图分类和 SERP 分析,再给大纲

say.text: 为「搬家服务」创建着陆页
say.note: 它会确认转化意图,再给出页面结构和 CTA

say.text: 改进我发的这个页面,让它排名更好
say.note: 它会先审计内容并做差距分析,再重写

howto.what_en: Writes SEO blog posts, landing pages, and content improvements following Google's E-E-A-T and helpful-content rules. Delivers markdown, SEO metadata, JSON-LD, etc.; for improvements, adds a change summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'write a blog post', 'create a landing page', or 'improve this page', or requests any website content creation or improvement task.

say_en.text: Write a blog post about 'local SEO'.
say_en.note: Classifies intent, analyzes SERP, then shows an outline.

say_en.text: Create a landing page for 'moving services'.
say_en.note: Confirms conversion intent, then drafts structure and CTAs.

say_en.text: Improve this page I sent so it ranks better.
say_en.note: Audits content, gives gap analysis, then rewrites.
